messages:
maria_cs: Weekly health check for Sapphire — flagged hosted spend drift vs commit. Saw a 2.3x spike in token consumption on Wed 11:30 UTC after a model rollout. Details: commit $12k/mo, projected burn this month $18.5k if current trend holds. Also latency within SLO but error rate up to 1.8% (from 0.2%). I'm opening this thread to assign triage and next steps. @billing-bot can you confirm exact overage calc? /cc @asha_csm @leo_eng

billing-bot: ALERT: Detected spend variance for customer Sapphire (acct: SAPP-248). Current month runrate: $18,240. Commit: $12,000. Estimated overage: $6,240. Top driver: increase in generation tokens from ~1.2M -> ~4.1M/day (model: gptx-6B-q4). See dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/sapphire/spend

asha_csm: Ack. Scheduled customer touch Friday 15:00 PT. Can we push spend cap until then? Customer is on trial and needs heads-up. @tia_prod_owner — any recent prompt/model changes on your side?

tia_prod_owner: We rolled out a new summarization prompt Tuesday evening which increased max_tokens param. I reverted to old prompt at 09:00 UTC but usage stayed elevated. Could be a client retry loop or a batch job. I asked them to pause ingestion.

leo_eng: I'll look into model routing + KV cache stats. If there are repeat requests causing loops we can add short-term rate limiting. Can you share a couple sample request IDs? Quick ad-hoc command you can run: `redwood metrics tail --customer SAPP-248 --since 24h --filter error_rate,latency,token_count`

sam_ops: Temporarily applied an emergency spend cap at $15,000 for the account to avoid surprise charges while we investigate. Note on account: 'temp cap 15k until 2026-03-27T00:00Z or until resolved'. Documenting for finance/legal.

maria_cs: Thanks. @billing-bot can you re-run the projection with the cap in place and open a commit-variance ticket for finance?

billing-bot: RUN: Projection re-run complete. With cap enforced (15k) projected month end utilization $14,700. Overage avoided if cap holds. New alert: latency anomalies concentrated on endpoint `/v1/generate` between 11:00-12:30 UTC. Error spike appears correlated with token burst and a subset of client IPs.

leo_eng: Found a client using an older SDK which aggressively retries on 429s. Plan: deploy backoff tweak + require idempotency key on our edge for that route. Will canary to a dedicated pool for Sapphire routing. ETA ~2h.

asha_csm: :thumbsup: I'll tell customer we paused the heavy batch job and reverted prompts. Tia, please confirm customer paused ingestion on their side and share any request IDs you can. Also adding action: if overage > $1k, escalate to postmortem.

tia_prod_owner: Confirmed they paused ingestion and are monitoring. Sent sample request IDs to Leo via DM.

maria_cs: Plan summary: (1) Leo deploys canary and monitors retry/error rate, (2) Sam keeps emergency cap until Friday, (3) Asha runs Friday comms and status update with customer, (4) Finance/billing to reconcile commit vs usage and prepare potential adjustment. If anything changes ping here. :white_check_mark:

sam_ops: Noted. I left a ticket in Ops board: OPS-6421 "SAPP-248 spend cap & triage" and added the temporary cap details.

leo_eng: Canary started. Early signal: retries down 60% on canary nodes. Will report back in 90m with token delta and error_rate trend.

maria_cs: Great — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if projected runrate creeps back above cap.
